name: Prosciutto, Mozzarella, Tomato, Pepper & Basil Sandwich with Arugula

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 lemon
2 tomatoes
1 yellow bell pepper
1 (5 oz) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Divide between a medium and small bowl. (Set the medium bowl aside for the salad.)
Zest lemon into the small bowl with the basil, then add mayo and spices. Stir to combine the basil aioli and set aside. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
½ tsp garlic powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds. Place on a plate and season with salt and pepper.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the plate with the tomato.
Slice mozzarella into thin rounds. Add to the plate and set aside.
Juice reserved lemon into the medium bowl with the basil. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp pure maple syrup
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
To assemble the sandwiches, spread each bread slice with basil aioli. Layer half of the slices with tomato, bell pepper, mozzarella, and prosciutto; close with remaining slices and cut in half.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!
